name: Schneider Electric
summary: Schneider publicly documents a TH110 switchgear thermal-monitoring route into EcoStruxure services. Rotating-machinery analysis is a separate route through equipment measurements and AVEVA Predictive Analytics; TH110 is not a vibration input.

flows.name: TH110 electrical thermal monitoring

steps.label: PowerLogic TH110
steps.detail: Batteryless, current-harvesting sensor measures electrical conductor and connection temperature using ZigBee Green Power.

steps.label: Panel Server or concentrator
steps.detail: EcoStruxure Panel Server or Harmony ZBRN32 collects TH110/CL110 wireless sensor data, depending on the switchgear configuration.

steps.label: Asset Advisor
steps.detail: Schneider's documented connected-service architecture passes recorded data to EcoStruxure Asset Advisor for electrical-asset condition monitoring.

steps.label: Service expert notification
steps.detail: Connected Service Hub experts interpret critical anomalies and proactively notify customers.

flows.caveat: This flow concerns electrical thermal risk; it does not establish mechanical vibration diagnosis or an automatic AVEVA connection.

flows.name: AVEVA rotating-equipment analytics

steps.label: Existing machinery sensors
steps.detail: A documented customer deployment used motor speed, temperature and bearing-vibration measurements gathered with SCADA and sensors.

steps.label: SCADA or historian data
steps.detail: AVEVA Predictive Analytics can integrate with existing historian systems; the customer example integrated SCADA and sensor data.

steps.label: AVEVA Predictive Analytics
steps.detail: Uses no-code AI and machine-learning models to detect deviations in equipment measurements and provide early warning.

steps.label: Reliability investigation
steps.detail: Alerts and diagnostic views support maintenance decisions; the exact work-order integration depends on deployment.

flows.caveat: AVEVA is a separate software route. The cited customer case does not show TH110 feeding its mechanical model.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §8: TH110 is a battery-free, energy-harvesting thermal sensor for electrical distribution.
findings.assessment: Schneider's TH110 manual confirms thermal measurement, electromagnetic energy harvesting and ZigBee Green Power; it is not a vibration sensor.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §8: TH110 has no battery-replacement outage, ever.
findings.assessment: The absence of a battery is supported, but the perpetual no-outage statement is broader than the vendor documentation; installation, faults and other maintenance remain possible.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §8: EcoStruxure Asset Advisor handles connected electrical asset health and remote experts.
findings.assessment: Schneider describes a TH110/CL110-to-Panel-Server-to-Asset-Advisor path and Connected Service Hub review.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §8: Schneider has no rotating-machinery health of its own and mechanical health only arrives through third-party vibration feeds into AVEVA.
findings.assessment: Schneider markets Asset Advisor for drives and rotating equipment; AVEVA also supports machinery measurements, including vibration. An exclusive AVEVA-only route and a universal absence of Schneider mechanical offerings are not supported.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-landscape-eight-majors.md §2: TH110 analysis is fixed thresholds plus load-compensated differential curves; AVEVA uses a specifically named OPTiCS algorithm in every deployment.
findings.assessment: These public sources support thermal measurements and multivariate predictive models, but do not establish those exact universal algorithm implementations.

unknowns: The cited public documents do not establish a TH110-to-AVEVA data path.
No comprehensive, current product inventory was established to prove the archive's absolute claims about lack of native vibration or API 670 hardware.
Exact Asset Advisor thermal rules and AVEVA model algorithms vary by product and deployment and were not established here.
